title: Split Concatenated Strings
goal: Solve Split Concatenated Strings: Given a concatenated string with embedded numbers indicating split points, extract all words and find the lexicographically largest rotation of any word.
strategy: Given a concatenated string with embedded numbers indicating split points, extract all words and find the lexicographically largest rotation of any word.
edgeCases: The cut can lie inside a string; choosing an orientation independently for every untouched string differs from choosing the cut string’s orientation.
